flashcard_questions.q: The process of dividing a market into distinct sub-groups of consumers who share similar characteristics or needs.
Dividing the market based on where customers live or where a product will be sold, such as urban vs rural or hot vs cold climates.
Statistical data about a population, including age, gender, ethnicity, family size, and occupation, used to identify customer groups.

flashcard_questions.a: Dividing the market based on how customers live, including their hobbies, values, and spending habits.
The money a person has left after income tax and National Insurance have been taken off their pay.
